data.name: Altamshon
data.gender_notes: Altamshon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Al-Tamr Ibn Murr, meaning 'pure gold'. This name is often given to boys born into families of great wealth and prestige. The name Altamshon carries the meaning “Pure Gold” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Altamshon usually hope their child will grow to embody pure gold and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the purity of the soul and the strength of character.
data.etymology: Altamshon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure Gold.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Altamshon total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

It implies a rich heritage and illustrious lineage, reflecting the high status and social standing of the child's family. This name can evoke images of grandeur, luxury, and wealth, and is often associated with the noble and respected members of society.

The term "Al-Tamr" in the name symbolizes the inner purity and righteousness of a person, as gold is considered a pure and valuable element. The name encourages the bearer to strive for spiritual growth and to embody the elemet's qualities of luster, radiance, and value. This name serves as a constant reminder for the child to uphold the virtues of faith, patience, and truthfulness, and to lead a life that brings honor to both themselves and their community.
